in_sanskrit.name: निपु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is near (to someone).

in_hindi.name: निपु
in_hindi.meaning: नि (निकलना, to come out) + पु (पुत्र, son)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who comes out as a son.

in_tamil.name: நிபு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is near (to someone) like a son.

in_telugu.name: నిపు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is near (to someone) like a son.

in_marathi.name: Nipu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nipu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipun', meaning 'excellent' or 'perfect'. Nipu refers to a gift, offering, or something that is exceptional in quality.

in_bengali.name: Nipu
